title: Calendar / habits / money integrated preview
human_intent: Keep improving the mobile-first life/calendar preview with very low friction, coherent time geometry and useful habits/money projections without turning it into a generic dashboard or duplicating global Prometeo capabilities.
must_preserve: Canonical data ownership stays separate from views/projections.
The visible habit history has fourteen equal day columns ending at HOY.
Daily marks and momentum points use the same fourteen X centers.
Momentum is derived from behavior logs; it is not a second persisted truth.
Compressed whole-week free time is one passive full-width band; visible 30-minute empty slots remain interactive.
Dynamic content must remain reachable; one surface has one vertical scroll owner.
Unknown habit state is neutral, not automatic failure.
global_capabilities_to_consider: If voice/intention entry is requested, do not build a local microphone; read the p4-capture delta/pack first.
If gestures/overlays change, reuse Input Ownership/Focus Lease rules rather than stacking listeners.
high_value_targets: Reduce human actions/friction rather than add decorative information.
Keep calendar, habit and momentum geometry visually aligned.
Use critique + implementation + repair in one LAB turn when possible.
Promote only genuinely reusable discoveries; keep this product's visual identity local.
